description: Scripted HTTP scenarios for GiftingClient. Format and matching rules: conformance/README.md.

scenarios.name: getGifts returns data[] and ignores has_more
getMe returns the body
getReceivedGifts encodes the user id like encodeURIComponent
getReceivedGifts: UTF-8 percent-encoding, and -_.!~*'() stay as they are
sendGift with every field maps them to the wire names
sendGift omits fields that were not given
sendGift uses the caller's idempotency key verbatim and never puts it in the body
baseUrl: trailing slashes are removed
baseUrl with a path keeps the path
401 then success: one fresh token (forceRefresh true) and one repeat
401 twice: gives up after one refresh
401 on a send: the repeat carries the SAME idempotency key
500 then success: one quiet retry with the SAME idempotency key and the same token
503 twice: one retry only, then the error
500 on a read is retried too
401, refresh, then 500, then retry: three requests, all with the same key
500 then 401: the 401 after a retry is NOT refreshed
429 is retryable but never retried by the client
422 insufficient_balance: not retried, insufficientBalance true
network failure: status 0, network_error, retryable, not retried

error.message: Could not reach GiftingStack. Check your connection.

scenarios.name: network failure on the retry after a 500: repeated once more, then a network error

error.message: Could not reach GiftingStack. Check your connection.

scenarios.name: sendGift: a lost connection is repeated once with the same key, the second answer is the result
sendGift: two lost connections in a row end the call after 2 requests (network_error)

error.message: Could not reach GiftingStack. Check your connection.

scenarios.name: sendGift: a given idempotency key is kept for the repeat after a lost connection
sendGift: only one repeat per call: a lost connection, a 500 and a lost connection end it (3 requests)

error.message: Could not reach GiftingStack. Check your connection.

scenarios.name: error body that is not JSON: unknown_error and a generic message
empty error body
non-JSON 502 twice: the request id comes from the X-Request-Id header of the last response
JSON body without an error object
error with a type but no message keeps the type
request id: the header is used when the body has none
request id: the body wins over the header
404 gift not found on a send
2xx that is not JSON: invalid_response, no body text, not retried
2xx with a cut-off JSON body: invalid_response, request id from the header
